hypothesis: The 100% W-R22 mask-aware score may depend on the all-zero missing-tick indicator rather than general robustness. Without retraining, replace missing observations by frozen nonzero-fill and last-value-carried-forward representations and quantify accuracy degradation.
freeze: Preregister exactly three fill styles, three mask counts, all three input-generating families, two unseen swap positions, and classification prior to scientific first use. Do not change model after heldout.
training: Reuse unchanged W-R22 learned weights from development seeds240..255, 1728 paired samples/model, 16 weights+bias, 32 passes, no new training or model selection.
data_gen: Same W-R20 raw-generator and W-R21 candidate offset+79 with amplitude3 time-varying four-channel jitter. Mask candidate ticks in order [2,5,8,10,3,6] before swapping untouched tail rows. All-zero condition matches W-R22, all-255 inserts (255,255,255,255), previous-row copies the most recent unmasked candidate row (not source target). No external metadata supplied to models.
metrics: Report each 54-cell model's per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN, accuracy by fill style and mask count, plus aggregate. Preserve predictions for informative counterexamples.
classification: ENCODING_INVARIANT if both maskaware models score >=0.80 in EVERY nonzero-fill cell; PARTIAL if maskaware_augmented accuracy >=0.70 aggregated over nonzero fill cells without strict success; ENCODING_DEPENDENT otherwise. Do not reclassify strict negative if other arm succeeds.
safeguards: All swapped rows and anchor remain unmasked, guaranteeing distinct positive/negative candidates, identical candidate anchor/multiset within pair
